notes: Verified via live web search against AWS's own pages (not solely from training data) on lastVerified. Numbers below are what AWS documents; this file should be re-verified periodically since AWS can change Free Tier terms at any time -- do not treat lastVerified as a guarantee the numbers below still hold. Where sources disagreed (DynamoDB request-unit framing, CodeBuild minutes), this file keeps only the figure AWS's own pages state and marks the rest informational.

ec2.note: t2.micro or t3.micro depending on region; the actual eligible type list is looked up live via ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes, never hardcoded here.

free_plan.label: New-model Free plan (credit-based, accounts created on/after 2025-07-15)
free_plan.note: EC2/RDS/API Gateway usage draws from the credit balance rather than a separate free monthly allowance. AutoInfra still avoids these by default since 'Free Tier eligible' does not mean $0 on this plan.

paid_plan.label: New-model Paid plan (upgraded, or never eligible for Free)
paid_plan.note: Standard billing beyond the Always Free service limits below.

codeBuild.note: AWS documents free build minutes for small Linux compute types; exact current minutes are not enforced numerically by this evaluator -- use the smallest compute type and treat CodeBuild cost as a warning, not a hard limit, until re-verified.

denyList.reason: NAT Gateway is never Free-Tier-eligible and bills per-hour plus per-GB.
ALB/NLB free usage exists only on legacy accounts for 12 months and is not enabled by default; CloudFront handles routing instead.
API Gateway draws from credits on new-model accounts; Lambda Function URLs are used instead.
ElastiCache is not allowed by default; requires explicit opt-in and eligibility confirmation.
OpenSearch is not allowed by default; requires explicit opt-in and eligibility confirmation.
EKS is never Free-Tier-eligible (control plane bills hourly).
Route 53 hosted zones are not Always Free; use an external DNS provider with a CNAME to CloudFront instead.
Customer-managed KMS keys bill monthly; use AWS-managed keys instead.
Secrets Manager is not Always Free; use SSM Parameter Store SecureString instead.
An unattached Elastic IP bills hourly with no offsetting free allowance.
